history.reply: Baki compressors me aapko slider 70%, 80% guess karna padta hai aur file 51 KB ho jaye toh portal reject kar deta hai. PressZero me aap exact '50 KB' likhte ho aur ye binary search se exact limit par lock karta hai, wo bhi 0 server upload ke sath.
